parts.0.title: Hören — Listening
parts.0.instructions: Listen to each item and choose the right answer. In the real exam each item is played twice; here you can listen as often as you like, but try to listen at most twice.
parts.1.title: Lesen — Reading
parts.1.instructions: Read each short text and choose the right answer. Richtig = correct, Falsch = wrong.
writing.0.taskBn: You are applying for a library card. Fill in the form with your own details (write on paper).
writing.0.checklist.2: Address: street + number, then postcode + city
writing.0.checklist.4: I wrote my Beruf in one word
writing.1.taskBn: Write to your neighbour Frau Berger: you are not at home on Saturday; could she take in your parcel? Write 2–3 sentences.
writing.1.checklist.1: I gave the reason (nicht zu Hause)
writing.1.checklist.4: I ended with a greeting + my name
speaking.0.instructions: Look at each word and say a full sentence aloud. Then listen to the model and compare.
speaking.0.prompts.2.bn: Which country do you come from?
speaking.1.instructions: Make a question from the word on the card. Someone else (or you yourself) answers.
speaking.1.prompts.3.bn: Bread: how much does it cost?
speaking.2.instructions: Make a polite request; when you hear a request, respond (Ja, gern! / Tut mir leid …).
speaking.2.prompts.0.bn: Ask someone to open the door
